people.name: Ju Ho Jin
people.note: A multilingual interpreter who values precision and neutrality.

people.name: Cha Mu Hui
people.note: A world-famous actress plagued by visions of her breakout role, Do Ra Mi.

people.name: Kurosawa Hiro
people.note: A Japanese actor known as the 'Prince of Romance.'

people.name: Sin Ji Seon
people.note: A producer of Romantic Trip, once loved by Ho Jin.

people.name: Kim Yeong Hwan
people.note: A novelist and old friend of Ho Jin's late grandfather.

people.name: Yun Mi Jeong
people.note: Owner of a winery in Italy.

people.name: Kim Yu Jin
people.note: A ramen chef and Mu Hui's ex-boyfriend.

people.name: CEO An
people.note: Head of Mu Hui and Yong U's talent agency.

links.label: Ho Jin and Mu Hui grow closer while filming Romantic Trip together.
links.evidence: Mu-hee asks Ho-jin what Hiro thinks about her.

links.label: Mu Hui impulsively kisses Ho Jin by the lake, then blames it on Do Ra Mi.
links.evidence: Mu-hee instinctively kisses Ho-jin. She then pulls back, shocked, and says Do Ra-mi made her do it.

links.label: Ho Jin and Mu Hui agree to end things after Mu Hui's confession.
links.evidence: Ho-jin is quite upset and agrees to end things here.

links.label: Mu Hui's alter ego Do Ra Mi introduces herself to Ho Jin for the first time.
links.evidence: Ho-jin comes home to find Mu-hee waiting for him inside. She introduces herself as Do Ra-mi.

links.label: Do Ra Mi slips a pill into Ho Jin's drink to knock him out after warning him off Mu Hui.
links.evidence: He realises she put a pill in his glass of water, which makes him pass out.

links.label: Do Ra Mi tells Ho Jin that Mu Hui's mother killed her father and tried to kill her too.
links.evidence: Mu-hee is terrified that Ho-jin will find out her secret — her mother killed her father and tried to kill her too.

links.label: Ho Jin and Mu Hui confess their feelings for each other and kiss at last.
links.evidence: Ho-jin confesses to her as well. When she still doesn't understand, he kisses her.

links.label: Ho Jin and Mu Hui become a couple after their confession in Italy.
links.evidence: Mu-hee asks Ho-jin to stay and watch the light for a little longer.

links.label: They agree to date freely for a month without worrying about how it ends.
links.evidence: They decide to freely date each other for at least a month.

links.label: Mu Hui posts a photo with Yu Jin and his wife to kill the dating rumors and protect Ho Jin.
links.evidence: She posts a picture with Yu-jin and his wife, saying they are all friends, in order to quell the rumours.

links.label: Ho Jin tells Mu Hui that her parents are actually alive, not killed as she believed.
links.evidence: Ho-jin shows Mu-hee the photograph of her mother and then drops another bomb — her parents are actually alive.

links.label: Ho Jin serves as Cha Mu Hui's interpreter throughout the Romantic Trip shoot.
links.evidence: The interpreter is none other than Ho-jin and she is pleasantly surprised to see him.

links.label: Na Jin Suk is Ho Jin's older brother.
links.evidence: [Ho Jin's brother]

links.label: Yoon Mi Jung is Ho Jin's mother, who runs a winery in Italy.
links.evidence: Ho-jin's mother and the winery owner in Italy.

links.label: Ho Jin and his mother reconcile after 13 years of not speaking.
links.evidence: They had a fight and then didn't speak for 13 years... both of them apologise to each other and make up.

links.label: Mr Kim was Ho Jin's late grandfather's close friend and now looks after Ho Jin like family.
links.evidence: Mr Kim was a good friend of Ho Jin's grandfather.

links.label: Alberto is one of Ho Jin's close friends in Italy.
links.evidence: [Ho Jin's friend]

links.label: Ji Seon was Ho Jin's first love, whom he never forgot.
links.evidence: Ho-jin admits he had visited the island with a girl named Ji-seon, whom he once loved.

links.label: Ji Seon recommends Ho Jin as the interpreter for Romantic Trip.
links.evidence: Ho-jin is surprised when he learns Ji-seon is the one who recommended his name to the producers.

links.label: On the train to Busan, Ho Jin admits to Ji Seon that he once liked her.
links.evidence: On the train, Ho-jin admits to Ji-seon that he liked her.

links.label: Yong U and Ji Seon begin secretly seeing each other during the shoot.
links.evidence: She kisses him and is walking away when he pulls her in for another kiss.

links.label: Ji Seon becomes Yong U's fiancée after he proposes.
links.evidence: Yong-u is now her fiancé!

links.label: Yong U proposes marriage to Ji Seon before leaving for the UK.
links.evidence: He doesn't want to break up with her... he asks her to marry him.

links.label: Ji Seon was engaged to Na Jin Suk before calling off the wedding.
links.evidence: He plans on getting married to Ji-seon in the next month.

links.label: Ji Seon calls Jin Suk and tells him their relationship is over.
links.evidence: She tells him she cheated on him and that their relationship is over.

links.label: Hiro co-stars with Mu Hui on the dating show Romantic Trip.
links.evidence: The producers of a TV show called Romantic Trip are looking for a female actress to pair Hiro with.

links.label: Do Ra Mi, in control of Mu Hui's body, pulls Hiro in for a kiss on the flight home.
links.evidence: Do Ra-mi woke up on the flight and pulled Hiro in for a kiss.

links.label: Hiro tells Mu Hui at the Italian fort that he really likes her.
links.evidence: Hiro and Mu-hee meet at one of Italy's forts and Hiro tells her that he really likes her.

links.label: Hiro tells Mu Hui he knows she likes someone else and encourages her to go after him.
links.evidence: He tells her he knows she likes someone else and encourages her to go after him.

links.label: Hiro and Mu Hui remain close friends after their romance doesn't work out.
links.evidence: In it, she says she will root for him as a friend.

links.label: Nanami is Hiro's manager who accompanies him throughout the show.
links.evidence: [Hiro's manager]

links.label: Hiro's older sister teases him about his growing feelings for Mu Hui.
links.evidence: [Hiro's sister]

links.label: Mrs Cha raised Mu Hui as her adoptive mother after her parents' accident.
links.evidence: Mu-hee's paternal uncle's wife/Mu-hee adopted mother

links.label: Cha Chairman raised Mu Hui as her adoptive father, and is chairman of the Myeongjin Foundation.
links.evidence: Mu-hee's paternal uncle/Mu-hee's adopted father

links.label: Mr Cha tells Ho Jin that Mu Hui's mother wasn't married to her father and used the child to keep him close, leading to tragedy.
links.evidence: He tells Ho-jin about how Mu-hee's mother wasn't married to Mu-hee's father... which eventually led to tragedy.

links.label: Mu Hui's aunt admits she blamed her as a child because she looks just like her mother.
links.evidence: Her aunt says that she looks just like her mother.

links.label: Kim Yu Jin is Mu Hui's ex-boyfriend, a chef who left her for another woman.
links.evidence: She's come here to confront her ex-boyfriend, Yu-jin, who works as a chef at the restaurant and left Mu-hee for someone who works there.

links.label: Mu Hui confronts Yu Jin over leaving her for his pregnant new partner Eiko.
links.evidence: Mu-hee learns that his girlfriend is an older woman named Eiko, who is 7 months pregnant!

links.label: Eiko is Yu Jin's new partner and the mother of his child.
links.evidence: Mu-hee learns that his girlfriend is an older woman named Eiko, who is 7 months pregnant!

links.label: Eiko reveals to Mu Hui that the baby is actually her ex-husband's, not Yu Jin's.
links.evidence: She says the baby is her ex-husband's, not Yu-jin's.

links.label: CEO An is Yong U's uncle and head of the talent agency.
links.evidence: Mu-hee's agency CEO (Kim Yong-u's uncle)

links.label: CEO An offers Yong U a transfer to the sports department in Europe.
links.evidence: He is getting transferred to the sports department... he needs to move to Europe within one month.

links.label: Writer Cho hints to Ho Jin that Ji Seon told her he's liked someone for a long time.
links.evidence: She says Ji-seon mentioned that Ho-jin has liked someone for a long time.
